before_body:
Choosing matching family Christmas pajamas for 2026 starts with two decisions: the look your family likes and the sizes each person needs. Make a short list of styles, then check every family member’s fit before settling on one.

Think about when you’ll wear them, too: Christmas morning breakfast, a family movie evening or the photo you’ll send to relatives. If a Christmas card is the main reason for buying, use your photo date when planning your order.

How to choose a style

Plaid: simple tops or a tree design

For solid tops with patterned pants, choose Classic Red Plaid pajamas: red tops pair with red tartan plaid pants. The description lists a cotton-feel knit made of 100% polyester. For more detail on the top, Plaid Tree Trio pajamas feature three plaid and gold Christmas trees with gold script, paired with navy and red plaid pants.

Three newer designs add more plaid options. Buffalo Plaid Tree pajamas pair ivory tops, showing a red and black buffalo plaid tree above “MERRY Christmas” lettering, with red, black and white plaid pants. Green Plaid Merry Tree pajamas have black tops with green trim, a decorated tree and white lettering, plus green, black and white plaid pants. For a cooler palette, Blue Plaid Reindeer pajamas show a reindeer in a striped scarf with ornaments on its antlers, over blue and black plaid pants. All three come in Mother, Father and Child sizes.

Fair Isle: pattern across the outfit

Evergreen Fair Isle pajamas have green and white patterned bands edged with red stripes across the top and pants, with Mother, Father and Child roles. If you like a Fair Isle look in a one-piece shape, see the hooded onesies below.

Reindeer: two different moods

Plaid Reindeer pajamas pair red tops featuring a smiling reindeer with red and green plaid pants; the reindeer’s hat varies by role. For a humorous scene, Lights Out Reindeer pajamas show a reindeer tangled in Christmas lights on dark green tops, with reindeer and string lights on cream pants.

Stripes and a snowy village

Snowy Village Stripes pajamas combine green tops with red and white striped pants and green cuffs. The adult tops show a snowy village with a snowman and reindeer beneath “Merry Christmas.” The child top has its own festive graphic, a useful detail to check if you want the same picture on everyone’s top.

Slogans: choose the message and palette

We Are Family Red pajamas have red slogan tops and red plaid pants. We Are Family Evergreen pajamas use white tops with dark green raglan sleeves and green and red plaid pants. Choose the version whose colors suit your planned photo setting.

For another message with red plaid pants, consider Joyful Merry Blessed pajamas, with white script and green holly leaves, or Jolly Crew pajamas, with white script on red tops. Let It Snow pajamas pair navy and white lettering on red tops with red, white and navy plaid pants.

Onesies: a different outfit shape

If your family prefers a one-piece look, Snowflake Reindeer hooded onesies have reindeer ears and antlers on the hood, black ribbed cuffs and a red and white Fair Isle print with small green trees and hearts. Baby, Child, Mother and Father roles are listed.

Sizing the whole family

Every piece is sold separately per person, so you can buy exactly the sizes your family needs. Make a checklist with each person’s name, the relevant role and their chosen size. Check the selections and quantities before ordering; a family photograph on a product page doesn’t mean one selection includes everyone’s outfit.

Start with the youngest person. The Snowflake Reindeer hooded onesies include Baby sizes, while the two-piece pajama sets list Mother, Father and Child. Child labels are given by age; treat them as a starting point for checking measurements.

Open “Size guide & fit” on each product page for garment measurements in cm and inches. Measure a favorite pair that fits the wearer, matching the chart’s measurement method and units, then compare the relevant dimensions. Check tops and bottoms separately for a two-piece style. Use each adult’s own measurements, too; Mother and Father labels have separate size selections, and the largest listed size varies by design.

Keep the 30-day returns policy handy and read its terms before ordering, especially when choosing sizes for relatives you cannot measure yourself.

When to order for Christmas

Standard shipping is included on orders. Each product page shows an estimated delivery date, currently about 12–16 days after ordering. For US orders, the product pages currently estimate that ordering by December 8 will arrive before Christmas. That is an estimate; check the date on the product page when you order, since arrival is not guaranteed.

Work backward from the first occasion you need the pajamas for. A card photo or an early family gathering may mean ordering before your Christmas morning plans would suggest. Allow time to try everyone’s outfit on before that occasion.

Photo ideas for your Christmas card

  • Choose a simple background. Try a plain wall or an uncluttered corner near the tree so the pajama patterns have room in the frame.
  • Try facing a window. Take a test picture and check everyone’s face before arranging the whole family.
  • Check the lettering. Smooth the tops and move arms or props away from slogans if you want the message visible.
  • Leave space for your card layout. Take both horizontal and vertical pictures, with room around the group for cropping and a greeting.
  • Give everyone something simple to do. Read a holiday book together, then take a second picture looking at the camera.

Browse the matching family Christmas pajamas collection with your size checklist and occasion date nearby. For families who also want a daytime look, explore matching Christmas sweaters and choose a direction together.
